exposure: Bictegravir (BIC) exposure in pregnancy (including preconception BIC with continued use, preconception BIC with discontinuation, and BIC started in pregnancy)
outcome: Maternal HIV viral load at delivery
cohort: The study included 1256 liveborn infants from the Canadian Perinatal HIV Surveillance Program born between July 28, 2018, and December 31, 2023, whose mothers were exposed to antiretroviral regimens in pregnancy.
finding: Bictegravir exposure in pregnancy was not independently associated with adverse perinatal and early infant outcomes after adjusting for relevant risk factors.
mod_finding: There were no between-group differences in mode of delivery when comparing BIC-exposed infants to those exposed to non-BIC regimens.
